title: UTC daily report
skill: List every rule the report must follow

good: In src/reports/daily.js, dailyRevenue(orders) has three bugs. 1) It takes the day with createdAt.slice(0, 10), which is the date in the order's own offset. Group by the UTC date instead with utcDate() from src/dates/utc.js: "2026-03-01T23:30:00-05:00" belongs to 2026-03-02. 2) It sums Math.trunc(parseFloat(amount) * 100), which loses cents ("19.99" gives 1998). Use toCents() from src/money/cents.js. 3) It returns days in input order. Sort rows by date, oldest first. Keep the row shape { date, cents, orders }. Only change that file. Then run: node --test --test-reporter=tap test/*.test.js
lazy: The daily revenue report is wrong. Fix it.
